title: Inspect narrow replay console and worker version
changes: Record bounded narrow-window presentation evidence for a replay request and distinguish an older replay worker from the corrected worker.
validation: At a real Windows client size of 480×360 under Wine/Xvfb, the console displayed the pending replay request ID and parameters, then the successful result and copy hint. The corrected worker completed 102/102 frames with exact endpoint; parent state, frame and clock, original inputs and session pins stayed unchanged.

An earlier copied profile with the old worker stopped at frame 45 with Access denied; a source-bound profile with the previously corrected worker differed only in runtime hash and passed with status polling. This is consistent with the documented publication-sharing fix, but the denied OS operation was not reported. An initial GUI helper waited on the wrong response channel and did not attest normal parent close; corrected sessions closed normally.
limitations: The session label is abbreviated and one narrow replay does not prove all long labels/parameters, native Windows, physical input or complete operation parity.
